digest.component_or_area: DC outbound differ and comment/description sanitization
propositions: DC lacks convergence test suites for oversized comments and descriptions, unlike Cloud which has two suites to prevent incidents from truncation mis-convergence
The DC comment and description sanitizer both bind to WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT (32767), which is the documented default of jira.text.field.character.limit covering both field types per JRASERVER-28519
DC convergence tests driven through config fallback will silently resolve Cloud's backend instead of DC's, causing false-negative tests that pass while proving nothing about DC behavior

The _diff_comments function falls back to Cloud's sanitizer when no explicit sanitizer is injected, and compute_outbound_mutations has an OR-guarded fallback that fires if ANY of outbound_mapper, inbound_mapper, or links is omitted

Convergence must be verified by two-pass assertion (second pass plans no mutations) with identity/recording checks for the injected sanitizer, not by value-based assertions that pass under both DC and Cloud truncation
